annotations.text:
ONE HUE THROUGH THE WHOLE NEUTRAL RAMP

The first pass had cool inks (blue-leaning greys) over warm papers. That hue flip is what makes mid-greys look dirty. Every neutral now sits on hue 80 in OKLCH, from #26221C ink to #FBF8F4 paper — warm all the way down.

Three text greys, and all three clear 4.5:1 on all three grounds. The old #9AA0A7 I used for the ledger's "—" placeholders measured 2.57:1 and is gone.

FOUR SEMANTICS, ONE LIGHTNESS, ONE CHROMA

L 0.47, C 0.08, hue is the only variable: accent 200, positive 148, caution 75, attention 38. 0.08 is the highest chroma all four hues can actually hold in sRGB — above it two of them clip and the set stops being uniform, which is what happened in the first pass.

attention #814A39 is spent on STATE only: the row edge, the icon, the "Te laat" label. The reminder button went back to the accent — a routine action should never wear the alarm colour.

ICONS: ONE GRID, ONE OPTICAL WEIGHT

Every icon is drawn on a 20-unit box with round caps and joins. Stroke-width is scaled per render size so the painted line is 1.5px everywhere: 22px→1.36, 20px→1.5, 18px→1.67, 16px→1.88. The first pass mixed 1.6 through 2.0 at eight different sizes, which reads as ragged.

And the per-row padlocks are gone. Everything in the grootboek is posted, so a lock on every row said nothing. The marker column now carries exceptions only — here, the reversing entry.

TEN CLIENT COLOURS, HONESTLY MEASURED

L 0.55, C 0.07 — lighter and quieter than the semantics on purpose. Ten hues over a 300-degree arc with a 30-degree dead zone either side of the accent, so no client is ever mistaken for the UI's own colour (the old palette had a client literally equal to the accent).

The second strip on that artboard is the honest part: simulated deuteranopia collapses the ten to about five, and amber/lime become identical. Initials and name are load-bearing, not decoration.

Marker initials are pure #FFFFFF — the off-white paper tone only reaches 4.42:1 on the darkest client colour.

ONBOARDING: NO RAIL, NO CLIENT BAR, ONE COLUMN

There is no administration yet, so there is nothing to put in the bar. A 720px column, a step eyebrow with a 132px progress track, a serif display title.

Legal form is a radio group rendered as plain-language CHOICE CARDS — the formal term (B.V., Eenmanszaak) rides as a chip, never as the label (D2). Trade name and BTW number sit behind "Meer opties" (D4, FR-UX-006).

The period preview on step 2 is GET /v1/fiscal-years/preview rendered as chips; the done state lists what was seeded and offers exactly two exits.

LISTS AND DETAILS

Control edges are #8F8878 (border-strong, ADR-055), not the canvas's old #C1BDB7 hairline — the boundary of a control must clear 3:1.

Table rows: 48px comfortable, 40px compact; header 40px on surface-raised; totals on a 2px border-strong rule. Overdue rows carry attention on three things only: the edge, the icon, the word. The reminder button stays teal.

The PDF preview is document content, not UI: white paper, black ink, on the sunken surface, exactly like the receipt in ReviewStack.

FORMS AND THE DRAWER

Inputs 48px in page content, 44px inside a drawer or an editable table; label 13px/600 above with 5px gap; helper 13px muted below. Focus = 2px accent border + 3px 16% ring; the label turns accent too.

Validation errors land on the field the API names (the invoice catalogue already says "Regel {line}") — what happened, why, what next (D5).

A form that belongs to a list opens as a 480px DRAWER beside it, with a scrim over the page and a sticky footer: quiet + primary. Below 64rem it is a full-screen route.

SETTINGS

200px sub-nav beside a 720px column. Each section is a panel with a serif h2.

Security is four panels in the order a user thinks: password, authenticator, passkeys, sessions. Destructive actions are OUTLINED in attention, never filled (app.css .button--danger). The last remaining second factor cannot be removed — the button is disabled with the reason beside it (IAM-010f).

Density lives here (Ruim / Compact), not in the bar.

BANNER, EMPTY STATES, ERRORS, TOASTS

The verification banner is CAUTION, not attention: nothing is wrong yet. It sits between the bar and the page, is not dismissible, and blocked actions point at it instead of dying.

Every empty state: icon in a 48px disc, title 17/600, body ≤46ch muted, one creating action. Every error: what happened, why, the next step as a control.

Toasts bottom-left, paper + shadow-lg + a 3px family edge, with "Ongedaan maken" instead of a confirm dialog (D7).
